data.name: AI VS ARTISTS
data.detailed_description:
THE COMPETITION OF THE CENTURY

You Are a Prodigy

You are Jamie Henry, a prodigious artist with every starry award tattooed upon your sleeve, making a living by directing interactive movies at Valhalla Studios. You've achieved everything you ever dreamed of, but the sacrifices you made to get here still haunt you.

Creativity's Last Bastion

The tech mogul Scylla Corporation has proposed a contest: you and a team of humanity's finest artists must compete against their most cutting-edge AI model, Karibdis, in an all-out, live-streamed battle to create the best interactive movie possible under the same conditions. This is your chance to show what it truly means to be an artist in an age where digital creation is more streamlined and accessible than ever before.

Day-to-Day Strife

Over the course of the competition, you'll help your team members complete their assigned tasks and work together with your team to pursue a common goal, demonstrate your leadership, or take matters into your own hands if it seems like your team is struggling. The choice is ultimately yours as the leader to do what feels right.

An Uphill Battle

The human team is composed of artists from all walks of life: writers, musicians, programmers, vocalists, editors, and more. As the team lead, it's your job to rein in all of these... "unique" talents and produce a truly phenomenal work of art worthy of crushing your AI competitor. However, it won't be easy, as not everyone is on the same page about what to create or how to go about creating it...

Artificial Intervention

As the human team lead, you'll also have to contend with Karibdis itself as it attempts to wear down your morale. Combined with the ever-present audience and Jamie's own troubled past, you'll have your work cut out for you if you want to stand a chance of winning this competition.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB / AMD RX 580 8GB
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS Big Sur 11+
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core M
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-Compatable
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
